items.h: Supported Barcode Types: Code 39, Code 128, EAN/UPC, QR Code, PDF417, Data Matrix, Aztec, MaxiCode, DotCode, OCR, Postal Codes and more
Drop Resistance: Up to 2.13 metres (7 ft)

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Zebra DS4608 Handheld 1D/2D QR Imager XD USB Barcode Scanner is a high-performance wired barcode scanner designed for retail, warehouse, manufacturing, healthcare, and electronics environments. Equipped with advanced imaging technology, it delivers fast, accurate scanning of virtually any 1D or 2D barcode, including damaged, poorly printed, and high-density barcodes.

The DS4608 XD model is ideal for scanning tiny electronic components, PCB labels, and precision manufacturing barcodes while also handling standard retail barcodes and QR codes with exceptional speed. Its ergonomic design ensures comfortable all-day use, while the durable construction withstands drops and demanding work environments.

With plug-and-play USB connectivity, the scanner integrates easily with POS systems, inventory software, and warehouse management systems, making deployment quick and hassle-free.


Key Features

  • Reads 1D, 2D, and QR codes with high-speed imaging technology
  • XD (Extra High Density) model for tiny and high-density barcodes
  • High-resolution 1280 × 800 megapixel image sensor
  • Fast and accurate scanning of damaged or low-quality barcodes
  • USB plug-and-play interface for easy installation
  • Supports QR Code, Data Matrix, PDF417, Aztec, MaxiCode, and more
  • Ergonomic handheld design for comfortable extended use
  • Durable construction with up to 2.13m (7 ft) drop resistance
  • IP52-rated protection against dust and water splashes
  • Compatible with Windows POS systems and most barcode-enabled applications
